sections.label: Material facts
sections.summary: The author was arrested, tried by the District Court, Appeal Court and Supreme Court, and sentenced to life imprisonment. Photocopies of evidence were used, originals were never produced, and the Supreme Court failed to dismiss the case despite orders to obtain originals.

sections.label: Issue and actual outcome
sections.summary: The communication raised allegations of unfair trial, arbitrary arrest and detention, and life sentence. The Committee found violations of articles 10, 14 and 15 of the Covenant and concluded that the author’s rights were breached.

sections.label: Deciding body's reasoning
sections.summary: The Committee held that the prolonged proceedings, lack of impartiality, presumption of innocence violations, and denial of a proper defence breached article 14(1) and (5). It also noted the Supreme Court’s disregard for the Appeal Court’s decision on the Immigration Act, confirming violations of article 15(1) and article 14(7).

sections.label: General comparison factors and limits
sections.summary: The Committee emphasized that protection under article 14 applies to all persons facing criminal charges, regardless of sentencing status, and that the State must provide an effective remedy and prevent future violations, consistent with article 2 obligations.
